description: A native runtime submits a result and a different authorized principal accepts it.

steps.action: Make task Ready using current version
assertions: Assignment, policy and retry eligibility pass.

steps.action: Claim with native credential and matching runtime proof
assertions: One current run has a server lease and fence.
Run ends submitted and task has no active execution lease.

steps.action: Accept own agent result using a different credential
assertions: Submitting agent identity still denies self-acceptance.
Reviewer differs from submitting principal and agent.
Task, event and idempotency outcome commit together.
